## Glossary

**Bun only**  
Hivemind needs Bun (bun:sqlite, Bun.serve, Bun.sleep); Node is not supported.

**bun test src/**  
The test suite (bun:test, in-memory shared DB from src/test/setup.ts); tsc is the type check.

**claude mcp add**  
Claude Code command registerMcpServer runs to register the stdio server globally.

**.claude/CLAUDE.md**  
Project instructions init writes or appends, built by buildHivemindClaudeMd.

**.claude/settings.json**  
Project Claude settings where init writes the SessionStart hooks, only if none exist.

**CLAUDE_AGENT_LABEL**  
Optional label the hook gives the agent; it becomes part of the agent id.

**cli**  
Class: the hivemind CLI commands status, watch and join, wired with commander in src/cli.ts.

**configurePermissions**  
Adds auto-approve entries for every hivemind tool except hivemind_reset to ~/.claude/settings.json.

**dev-runtime**  
Class: the Bun-only runtime and the dev checks bun test src/ and tsc.

**extractMarkdownSection**  
Helper in src/init/claudeConfig.ts that pulls the Hivemind Events section out of the repo CLAUDE.md.

**hivemind CLI**  
The hivemind binary: install, init, status, watch, join (commander).

**Hivemind Events section**  
The CLAUDE.md section on concise events that init copies into each project.

**hivemind init**  
Per-project setup: DB, SessionStart hooks in .claude/settings.json, .claude/CLAUDE.md; -p, --no-hooks.

**hivemind install**  
One-time machine setup: claude mcp add at user scope plus tool auto-approval.

**hivemind join**  
Register an agent by hand from the terminal with -l label and -c context.

**hivemind watch**  
Live tail that polls new events every second.

**HIVEMIND_REMOTE_URL**  
When set, the hook calls hivemind_register and hivemind_status on a remote MCP server; needs HIVEMIND_API_TOKEN.

**hooks/session-start.sh**  
The plugin's hook script that runs the SessionStart hook.

**install-and-init**  
Class: hivemind install (machine) and hivemind init (project) wiring hivemind into Claude Code.

**matchers startup, compact, resume**  
The three SessionStart matchers hivemind init writes hook entries for.

**process.ppid**  
Claude's PID, which the local hook path stores on the agent for PID liveness.

**runSessionStartHook**  
The hook's entry in src/hooks/sessionStart.ts; reads stdin JSON, registers, reads status, prints context.

**session-start-hook**  
Class: the Claude Code SessionStart hook runSessionStartHook and its local and remote paths.

**session_id / cwd**  
Fields of the hook's stdin JSON; cwd gives the git repo, whose name is the project.

**SessionStart hook**  
Claude Code hook that registers the session as an agent and injects hivemind status into Claude's context.

**./setup.sh**  
Source-checkout installer; a wrapper for hivemind install.

## 1. What this Warden covers

The Claude Code side of hivemind: the SessionStart hook that registers each session and tells Claude its agent id, the install and init commands that wire the MCP server, permissions, hooks and project CLAUDE.md into Claude Code, and the terminal CLI.

## 2. The domain

The SessionStart hook (runSessionStartHook in src/hooks/sessionStart.ts, run by `bun run <hivemind>/src/hooks/sessionStart.ts` or the plugin's hooks/session-start.sh) fires on startup, resume and compact. It reads the hook's stdin JSON (session_id, cwd), takes the git repo name as the project and, locally, registers the agent with process.ppid through executeRegister and reads executeStatus; with HIVEMIND_REMOTE_URL set (HIVEMIND_API_TOKEN required) it calls hivemind_register and hivemind_status on the remote server through the MCP client instead. CLAUDE_AGENT_LABEL adds a label to the agent id. It prints the agent's context for Claude and never starts the coordinator. What registering does lives in agents-and-liveness.

Setup has two levels. installCommand (`hivemind install`; ./setup.sh from a source checkout wraps it) is one-time per machine: registerMcpServer runs `claude mcp add --transport stdio --scope user hivemind` guarded by isMcpRegistered, and configurePermissions auto-approves every tool except hivemind_reset. initCommand (`hivemind init`, -p, --no-hooks) is per project: it creates the DB and calls initClaudeConfig, which writes getHivemindHooks' startup/compact/resume entries into .claude/settings.json only when no SessionStart hooks exist, and writes or appends .claude/CLAUDE.md from buildHivemindClaudeMd, which copies the repo CLAUDE.md's 'Hivemind Events' section. Prefer running the commands over calling the building blocks.

The CLI (commander, src/cli.ts) adds statusCommand (one-shot snapshot), watchCommand (polls new events every second) and joinCommand (register by hand with -l label, -c context). Hivemind runs on Bun only (bun:sqlite, Bun.serve); dev checks are `bun test src/` and `tsc`, with no linter. Not here: the agent record, reconnect and liveness (agents-and-liveness), serving the tools and HIVEMIND_API_TOKEN on the server (mcp-server), the DB file and hivemind_setup (storage-and-primitives), the event guidance's emit tool (event-log), git repo-name detection (git-and-worktrees).

## 4. The specifics, in full

### 4a. Doc sections

Each unit is the doc section verbatim, with its headings shifted down two levels. A source line above it gives the path, the section and the doc's H1.

<!-- unit doc:ARCHITECTURE.md#core-components -->
**Source:** `ARCHITECTURE.md` § Core Components (in "Hivemind Architecture")

#### Core Components

##### 1. SessionStart Hook (`src/hooks/sessionStart.ts`)
- Runs when Claude starts, resumes or compacts (matchers `startup`, `resume`, `compact`)
- Reads the hook's stdin JSON (`session_id`, `cwd`); the project is the git repo name
- Locally: registers the agent with `process.ppid` (Claude's PID) through `executeRegister`, then reads `executeStatus`
- With `HIVEMIND_REMOTE_URL` set (needs `HIVEMIND_API_TOKEN`): calls `hivemind_register` and `hivemind_status` on the remote MCP server instead
- An optional label comes from `CLAUDE_AGENT_LABEL`
- Outputs agent info to Claude's context
- Does not start the coordinator (see below)

##### 2. Coordinator (`src/coordinator/index.ts`)
- Singleton per project (`coordinator.pid` and `coordinator.lock` in the project data dir)
- Started as a detached `bun` process by `ensureCoordinator` (`src/coordinator/spawn.ts`), which `hivemind_emit` calls on every emit; nothing else starts it
- Sweeps every 30 seconds
- Local mode: checks if agent PIDs are alive via `process.kill(pid, 0)`, with a 1-minute grace period for new agents; agents without a PID are left alone
- Network mode: marks agents whose lease expired
- Starts the plan watcher
- Runs indefinitely

##### 3. MCP Tools (`src/mcp/tools/`)
Defined once in `src/mcp/core.ts` (`HIVEMIND_TOOL_DEFS`, `executeToolByName`, `createMcpServer`) and served over stdio (`src/mcp/server.ts`) or HTTP (`src/mcp/httpServer.ts`).

- `hivemind_setup` - Initialize project database
- `hivemind_register` - Register agent (reconnects by session ID, then PID)
- `hivemind_emit` - Emit events for other agents
- `hivemind_query` - Query events (by since, plan, agent or branch)
- `hivemind_status` - Get hivemind status
- `hivemind_events` - Get recent events
- `hivemind_claim_task`, `hivemind_start_task`, `hivemind_complete_task` - Task workflow
- `hivemind_worktree_cleanup` - Find and clean up stale worktrees
- `hivemind_reset` - Reset database (delete and recreate schema)

##### 4. HTTP Server (`src/mcp/httpServer.ts`)
- `bun run mcp:http`; listens on `PORT` (default 8787), hostname `0.0.0.0`
- `GET /health` returns `{ ok, mode: 'network', sessions }`
- `/mcp` requires `Authorization: Bearer <HIVEMIND_API_TOKEN>`; each MCP session (`mcp-session-id`) gets its own streamable HTTP transport

##### 5. Database Schema

**agents** - Claude sessions
```sql
id, hex, label, status, pid, session_id, last_seen_at,
current_plan_id, current_task_id, worktree_id,
context_summary, created_at
```

**events** - Communication log
```sql
id, hex, seq, timestamp, agent_id, plan_id, task_id,
worktree_id, branch, event_type, content, metadata
```

**plans** - High-level work items
```sql
id, hex, label, title, description, status, branch,
worktree_id, claude_session_id, created_at, created_by
```

**tasks** - Granular work items within plans
```sql
id, plan_hex, seq, label, plan_id, title, description,
status, branch, worktree_id, claimed_by, claimed_at,
completed_at, outcome, parent_task_id
```

**worktrees** - Git worktrees
```sql
id, hex, label, path, branch, commit_hash, is_main,
status, created_at, last_seen
```

<!-- unit doc:ARCHITECTURE.md#data-flow -->
**Source:** `ARCHITECTURE.md` § Data Flow (in "Hivemind Architecture")

#### Data Flow

##### Agent Registration
```
Claude starts → SessionStart hook
  → executeRegister() (init DB if needed, create or reconnect agent with PID)
  → executeStatus()
  → Output to Claude's context
```

##### Event Communication
```
Agent emits event → hivemind_emit MCP tool
  → ensureCoordinator() (start if needed)
  → Insert into events table
  → Other agents query via hivemind_query
```

##### Plan Sync
```
Claude enters plan mode → Creates file in ~/.claude/plans/
  → Plan watcher (in the coordinator) detects changes
  → Skips files whose `project:` frontmatter names another project
  → Extract tasks from markdown (regex)
  → Reconcile tasks with database
  → Tasks linked to plan
```

<!-- unit doc:ARCHITECTURE.md#configuration -->
**Source:** `ARCHITECTURE.md` § Configuration (in "Hivemind Architecture")

#### Configuration

##### Claude Settings (`.claude/settings.json`)
```json
{
  "hooks": {
    "SessionStart": [{
      "matcher": "startup",
      "hooks": [{
        "type": "command",
        "command": "bun run /path/to/hivemind/src/hooks/sessionStart.ts"
      }]
    }]
  }
}
```

`hivemind init` writes one such entry for each of the matchers `startup`, `compact` and `resume`, and only when the project has no SessionStart hooks yet.

##### MCP Server
Registered globally via `claude mcp add` (`hivemind install`).

<!-- unit doc:README.md#environment-variables -->
**Source:** `README.md` § Environment Variables (in "Hivemind")

#### Environment Variables

- `HIVEMIND_API_TOKEN`: required for `bun run mcp:http`
- `PORT`: HTTP port for network mode (default `8787`)
- `HIVEMIND_REMOTE_URL`: when set in hook/agent environments, session-start register/status calls go to remote MCP instead of local DB logic
- `HIVEMIND_AGENT_LEASE_TTL_SECONDS`: lease TTL for stale-agent sweep in network mode (default `180`)
- `HIVEMIND_NETWORK_MODE`: liveness mode toggle (`1/true` enables lease-based mode). `mcp:http` enables this automatically.
- `HIVEMIND_BASE`: base directory for project DB/state (defaults to `~/.hivemind`)
- `CLAUDE_AGENT_LABEL`: optional label the session-start hook gives the agent (it becomes part of the agent ID)

<!-- unit doc:CLAUDE.md#hivemind-events -->
**Source:** `CLAUDE.md` § Hivemind Events (in "Hivemind")

#### Hivemind Events

Emit concise events to coordinate. **Under 80 chars.** Map, not territory.

```
hivemind_emit type=decision content="Redis for cache, Postgres for persistence"
hivemind_emit type=context content="API rate limit: 100/min per key"
hivemind_emit type=note content="003 done, starting 004"
```

**Emit for:** architectural decisions, discoveries others need, blockers, questions.

**Skip:** routine progress, obvious steps, anything verbose.

<!-- unit doc:README.md#installation -->
**Source:** `README.md` § Installation (in "Hivemind")

#### Installation

Hivemind needs the [Bun](https://bun.sh) runtime: it uses `bun:sqlite` and `Bun.serve`.

##### From npm

```bash
npm install -g @inixiative/hivemind
```

Then add to Claude Code:

```bash
claude mcp add hivemind -- hivemind-mcp
```

Or manually add to `~/.claude/settings.json`:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "hivemind": {
      "command": "hivemind-mcp"
    }
  }
}
```

##### From source

```bash
git clone https://github.com/inixiative/hivemind.git
cd hivemind
./setup.sh
```

Restart Claude Code and hivemind is active.

On startup, Claude receives context about the hivemind state:
```
hivemind: agt_7a3f2b joined myproject (main)
  session: abc123-def456
  active: agt_c4d5e6_alice
```

This info goes into Claude's system context (not printed to terminal). Claude knows its agent ID and can see other active agents.

<!-- unit doc:README.md#cli -->
**Source:** `README.md` § CLI (in "Hivemind")

#### CLI

```bash
hivemind install    # One-time global setup
hivemind init       # Register current project
hivemind status     # Show project status
hivemind watch      # Live tail of events
hivemind join       # Join as an agent
```

#### Development

```bash
bun install
bun test
bun run src/cli.ts status -p hivemind
```

### 4b. Code entries

From the catalog (extracted from the code, described by a model). Each line: **name** `where` [kind] the job it does. Use: canonical usage.

#### Class `session-start-hook`
- **runSessionStartHook** `src/hooks/sessionStart.ts#runSessionStartHook` [primitive] register the starting Claude session as an agent and read hivemind status for it Use: bun run <hivemind>/src/hooks/sessionStart.ts (set by `hivemind init`)

#### Class `install-and-init`
- **buildHivemindClaudeMd** `src/init/claudeConfig.ts#buildHivemindClaudeMd` [primitive] build the hivemind CLAUDE.md text for a project, with an optional custom events section Use: buildHivemindClaudeMd(projectName, customEventsSection?)
- **configurePermissions** `src/cli/registerMcp.ts#configurePermissions` [primitive] add auto-approve permissions for hivemind tools to ~/.claude/settings.json Use: configurePermissions()
- **getHivemindHooks** `src/init/claudeConfig.ts#getHivemindHooks` [primitive] build the settings.json SessionStart hook entries that auto-register agents Use: getHivemindHooks(hivemindRoot)
- **initClaudeConfig** `src/init/claudeConfig.ts#initClaudeConfig` [primitive] write hivemind's Claude Code configuration (CLAUDE.md, hooks) into a project Use: initClaudeConfig(projectRoot, project, hivemindRoot)
- **initCommand** `src/cli/init.ts#initCommand` [primitive] set up hivemind in a project, resolving the project name from git info Use: bun run src/cli.ts init
- **installCommand** `src/cli/install.ts#installCommand` [primitive] install hivemind on this machine for Claude Code Use: bun run src/cli.ts install
- **isMcpRegistered** `src/cli/registerMcp.ts#isMcpRegistered` [primitive] check whether the hivemind MCP server is already registered via `claude mcp list` Use: if (!(await isMcpRegistered())) { ... }
- **registerMcpServer** `src/cli/registerMcp.ts#registerMcpServer` [primitive] register the hivemind MCP server with Claude Code via `claude mcp add` Use: await registerMcpServer(hivemindRoot)

#### Class `cli`
- **joinCommand** `src/cli/join.ts#joinCommand` [primitive] join the current git project to a hivemind, using its git info Use: bun run src/cli.ts join
- **statusCommand** `src/cli/status.ts#statusCommand` [primitive] show hivemind status for the current project, resolved from git info Use: bun run src/cli.ts status
- **watchCommand** `src/cli/watch.ts#watchCommand` [primitive] watch hivemind activity for a project, given as an option or detected Use: bun run src/cli.ts watch [--project <name>]
